title: Hold an authority to generate or transmit electricity
what: Connect generating plant to a transmission grid or supply network only under a generation authority, and operate a transmission grid only under a transmission authority.

sources.title: Electricity Act 1994 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not connect generating plant to a transmission grid or supply network unless the person is the holder of a generation authority

sources.title: Electricity Act 1994 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not operate a transmission grid unless the person is the holder of a transmission authority
